overrides.citation: Kothuri et al. 2025 Zenodo record 14170681, Bone Constituents, 810-nm trabecular-bone row
overrides.conversion: Arithmetic mean of three exact 810-nm cm^-1 replicates divided by 10; mus=musp/(1-0.89).
overrides.notes: Porous trabecular endpoint for the diploic/marrow atlas label; not a claim that trabecular bone equals marrow.
